courses.note: The BS Computer Science major core requires neither a software engineering course nor a capstone. CSE 2213 Methods and Tools in Software Development is required but is not a software engineering or capstone course. The software engineering courses (CSE 4214, CSE 3213/3223 Senior Project) belong to the separate BS Software Engineering major.
